query: select id as public_witness_post_id, substring(content from 'data-href="[^"]*(?:801439149946390|839307259461807)[^"]*"') as exact_video_ref, substring(content from '<blockquote[^>]+cite="[^"]*(?:801439149946390|839307259461807)[^"]*"') as blockquote_ref, substring(content from 'https://www.facebook.com/(?:86AND26|k1820)') as explicit_provider_account from public.posts where id in (1341,1362) and not (coalesce(tags,'{}') && array['טיוטה','פורום']) order by id
